top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards an identifiable original experiment, the 2018 transport observation of correlated insulating and superconducting states at the magic angle, preceded by a quantitative prediction (Bistritzer and MacDonald, 2011) and reproduced by many independent groups with transport, scanning probes and spectroscopy. It opens a new door: gate voltage and twist angle as knobs on correlated matter in one material. The citation can rest on observed phases, not the open pairing mechanism. The Andrei and Cao attribution question remains a real weakness, but P001 is the more mature discovery-type achievement; P002 is a strong, cross-checked instrument advance but sits close to the 2005 and 2012 metrology prizes, and I prefer an award to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile (shares a first name with Eva Y. Andrei, who is not in P001's laureate set; no known relationship; Chalmers colleague Goran Johansson is not credited in any proposal)
